test_modeloutput_attribute_access: test the ModelOutput class supports attribute access and raises AttributeError for missing fields
test_modeloutput_indexing: test the ModelOutput class supports integer, slice, and string-based indexing with KeyError for missing keys
test_modeloutput_dict_like: test the ModelOutput class supports dict-like keys, values, items iteration and rejects mutation operations
test_modeloutput_instantiation: test the ModelOutput class can be instantiated from a dictionary or an iterator of key-value pairs
test_modeloutput_torch_pytree: test the ModelOutput class integrates with torch pytree for tree_flatten and tree_unflatten operations
